measure.measure_definition: Pathological complete response (pCR) assessed on the surgical specimen after the complete Dato-DXd-led treatment strategy across Blocks A–C or protocol-directed early surgery. Model-estimated and observed pCR summaries refer to this same clinical criterion; their statistical summaries are distinguished in result rows.

Residual Cancer Burden (RCB) class at surgery after the complete Dato-DXd-led strategy or protocol-directed early surgery. The supplied Supplementary Figure 2 identifies RCB 0 (pCR), RCB 1, RCB 2 and RCB 3. The HR-negative/HER2-negative/Immune-negative/DRD-negative RCB-evaluable subtype has n=10; patients assigned non-pCR because of withdrawal before surgery or additional non-protocol therapy were excluded from this RCB analysis.
measure.measure_name: Residual Cancer Burden (RCB) class at surgery
